title: 2023 Panini Select - Concourse Black and Green Prizm Die-Cut #6 Drake London
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2023 Panini Select sports trading card features Drake London of the Atlanta Falcons. The card is part of the Concourse Black and Green Prizm Die-Cut set and has a card number of 35. It is a rookie card and also includes features such as the parallel/variety die-cut design. The card is perfect for collectors and fans of the National Football League (NFL) and comes from the reputable manufacturer Panini. This is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and is sure to impress.
